boneArmorAbsorb.description: Finite nonnegative personal absorption per allocated Bone Armor rank.

summonLifePct.description: Finite nonnegative per-rank global summon bonus fraction.

summonAttackPct.description: Finite nonnegative per-rank global summon bonus fraction.

summonResistAllPct.description: Finite nonnegative per-rank global summon bonus fraction.

elementalDamagePct.description: Finite nonnegative per-allocated-rank fraction; elementalDamagePct applies only to fire and cold.

critChancePct.description: Finite nonnegative critical-chance fraction per allocated Critical Strike rank.

attackPct.description: Finite nonnegative fresh Attack fraction per allocated Penetrate rank.

physDodgePct.description: Finite nonnegative physical-dodge fraction per allocated Dodge rank.

magicDodgePct.description: Finite nonnegative magical-dodge fraction per allocated rank.

physicalDamagePct.description: Finite nonnegative direct physical-damage fraction per allocated Pierce rank.

defensePct.description: Finite nonnegative ordinary-defense fraction per allocated rank of the paid player Frozen Armor buff.

fireDamagePct.description: Finite nonnegative fire increased-damage fraction per allocated Fire Mastery rank.

lightningDamagePct.description: Finite nonnegative lightning increased-damage fraction per allocated Lightning Mastery rank.

defensePct.description: Finite nonnegative ordinary-defense fraction per allocated Iron Skin rank.

summonLifePct.description: Finite nonnegative summon-life fraction per allocated Skeleton Mastery rank.

summonAttackPct.description: Finite nonnegative summon-Attack fraction per allocated Skeleton Mastery rank.

summonDefensePct.description: Finite nonnegative summon ordinary-defense fraction per allocated Skeleton Mastery rank.

physicalDamagePct.description: Finite nonnegative physical increased-damage fraction per allocated player Might rank.

attackPct.description: Finite nonnegative Attack-stat fraction per allocated player Might rank.

manaRegenPct.description: Finite nonnegative fraction of the source hero's normal mana recovery per allocated player Meditation rank.

cleansing.description: Exact selected Cleansing finite poison/curse duration reduction and independent recovery; Prayer-only auraHealing remains separate.

durationMultiplier.description: Finite duration factor applied once per status application or first eligible wave admission; a transient status marker prevents repeated carry reduction.

healing.description: Independent Cleansing base healing and interval; no Prayer rank or implicit Vitality baseline.

auraHealing.description: Exact selected Prayer periodic healing, copied at each wave boundary without persisted timers.

intervalMs.description: Simulation milliseconds between heals, including the first full interval after wave entry.

amount.description: Finite positive base HP before the allocated-rank lifeRegenPct modifier, integer floor and missing-HP cap.

auraPulse.description: Exact selected player Holy Fire/Shock deterministic pulse; copied at the wave boundary.

intervalMs.description: Simulation milliseconds between pulses, including the first pulse after wave entry.

damage.description: Finite positive base damage before source increases, combos and ordinary mitigation.

durationMs.description: Canonical Burn base duration in simulation milliseconds.

dotPctOfDamage.description: Finite fraction of mitigated pulse damage per second per Burn stack.

conviction.description: Exact selected player Conviction enemy resistance reduction, applied before existing resistance penalties and clamps.

enemyResistReductionPct.description: Finite percentage points subtracted from each enemy resistance while the selected source hero lives.

venomOnBasicHit.description: Exact Assassin Venom basic-hit coating: fraction of snapshot Attack per second, then poison mitigation once.

monsterSummon.description: Reviewed Blood Raven monster-archetype summon batch and death policy.

attackDamagePct.description: Finite nonnegative percentage of snapshot Attack added before damage multipliers and mitigation; exact Basic/Pierce mercenary rows only.

requiredLevel.description: Character level required to unlock this skill

prerequisites.description: Array of skill IDs that must be learned first

passive.description: True if this is a passive skill with always-on effect

aura.description: True if this is a toggled aura skill (Paladin)

summon.description: True if this skill summons a creature

summonBasicAttackElements.description: Ordered fresh-batch basic attack elements for the exact authored Skeletal Mage skill. Each of the four elements appears once; order is tuning.

summonId.description: Registered summon template id spawned by this skill

aoeShape.description: Optional AOE shape on the 3-column battle grid. Does not imply attack range or movement.

staticField.description: Current-health lightning fraction and maximum-health nonlethal floors; exact player Static Field only.

holyFreeze.description: Native mercenary Holy Freeze party direct cold increase in percentage points; slowing uses the shared Chill definition.

coldDamagePct.description: Additive increased direct cold damage in percentage points.

coldMastery.description: Bearer-only direct cold resistance penetration for the exact player Cold Mastery passive, in percentage points.

resistanceReductionPct.description: Resistance percentage points ignored at allocated rank one.

resistanceReductionPerRankPct.description: Additional resistance percentage points ignored per allocated rank above one.

statusEffect.description: Runtime metadata for the first appliesStatus id, such as DoT strength or stack count.

durationMs.description: Finite base duration in simulation milliseconds; consumed by the production Amplify Damage debuff.

physicalResistReductionPct.description: Finite physical resistance reduction in percentage points; consumed by the production Amplify Damage debuff.

defenseReductionPct.description: Finite ordinary-defense reduction percent; consumed by mercenary Inner Sight with positive durationMs.

additionalStatusEffects.description: Exclusive opt-in secondary metadata: primary plus Freeze, or exact Meteor Burn plus Armor Melt.

armor-melt.description: Exact Meteor secondary: certain application with authored ordinary-defense reduction and finite positive milliseconds.

heal.description: Exactly one flat inclusive range or percentage of maximum Life; never mixed.

pctOfMaxLife.description: Fraction of maximum Life, floored by the healing engine.

^(cold|fire|lightning|poison|physical|ar.description: Damage multiplier for this combo tag

monsterLevelDamageGrowth.description: Exact Act I Lightning affix: min/max damage growth per effective monster level above one; range order is checked by the leaf adapter.

summonStatsPerLevel.description: Flat per-skill-rank growth applied to the summoned unit template at runtime and in skill previews.

passiveStatsPerLevel.description: Visible per-rank passive/utility growth for non-damage skill previews. Runtime hooks may consume these as systems mature.

requires.description: Equipment gate. The currently equipped weapon must satisfy each provided whitelist for the skill to be usable.
